record.question: City of Dreaming Spires
record.explanation: Answer D: Oxford. Oxford is the City of Dreaming Spires. Oxford University Museum of Natural History’s own description identifies that nickname and its origin in Matthew Arnold’s 1866 poem Thyrsis. Historical/source note: A literary nickname for Oxford’s skyline, not an official designation. Reference: https://shop.oumnh.ox.ac.uk/products/tote-bag-oxford-skyline. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
